correctness.rationale: For each integer n>=3 over C, the general pencil of skew forms gives smooth X=S_2Gr(2,2n+1) as codimension-two Pluecker hyperplane complete intersection in G=Gr(2,2n+1). Fonarev–Kuznetsov Theorem 1.1 yields affine paving, torsion-free purely even cohomology and the middle rank n. Integral Schubert Pieri and [X]=x² yield middle Schubert restriction Gram matrix tridiagonal with diagonal 2 except final 1, adjacent 1, determinant 1; unimodularity proves the proposed n middle classes form an integral basis. Integral weak Lefschetz supplies restriction below middle. Multiplication by x² on low-degree Schubert bases has a unitriangular full-rank square minor, hence primitive image; PD and Gysin duality extend integral restriction surjectivity to all high degrees. Projection formula i_* i^*(alpha)=x² alpha and injectivity of i_* then give ker i^*=Ann_G(x²), yielding the colon ideal Z[x,y]/((f_{2n},f_{2n+1}):x²), f_j=xf_{j-1}-yf_{j-2}. Cellular cycle map is ring isomorphism CH*≅even H*. The top Pluecker degree is Catalan C_{2n-1}, versus C_{2n-2} of Gr(2,2n), distinguishing graded integral rings despite matching additive ranks. Independently calculated det middle matrices =1 for n2..11 and checked partition-degree integrality; finite checks are not universal proof. n=2 explicitly prior calibration, not a claim of novelty.

value.rationale: Determining *integral* intersection multiplication and integral middle-lattice saturation in a natural Fano Grassmannian subfamily is mathematically meaningful, not merely repackaging Betti numbers. The primary affine-paving paper specifically left the multiplicative ring as a separate problem. The full colon-ideal presentation and degree-based obstruction to ring isomorphism resolve this concrete gap for all odd pencil dimensions n>=3; the known n=2 case is carefully excluded from the novelty claim.
